name: emfluence Marketing Platform
author: emfluence interactive marketing

sections.description:
The emfluence Marketing Platform is intuitive marketing automation built for marketers—email, SMS, and drag-and-drop workflow automation with real human support when you need it. Connect your WordPress site to the platform in minutes with the free emfluence WordPress plugin.

Build a relationship with your audience and grow your business with emfluence. The plugin connects your site to your marketing platform so you can capture subscribers, sync contacts automatically, and route transactional email through emfluence—without copying embed codes or juggling separate tools.

Use emfluence to:

  • Capture leads with ease — build signup forms in WordPress and sync every submission to your emfluence contact database.
  • Nurture your audience — turn new subscribers into customers with email, SMS, and automated workflows in the emfluence platform.
  • Segment and target — assign contacts to groups, enable double opt-in, and send the right message to the right list.
  • Improve deliverability — optionally route WordPress transactional email through emfluence instead of your host’s default mail.
  • Scale with a platform that grows with you — landing pages, reporting, integrations, and a team that picks up the phone.

Don’t have an account yet? Start a 14-day free trial or request a demo.

Contact capture & list growth

Every form submission creates or updates a contact in the emfluence Marketing Platform—ready for campaigns, automations, and segmentation. No manual exports. No duplicate data entry.

  • Lead capture on any page or post
  • Automatic contact sync to your emfluence account
  • Group targeting and list assignment
  • Double opt-in and consent management
  • Custom fields from your emfluence account
  • Honeypot, Cloudflare Turnstile, and Google reCAPTCHA v3 spam protection

Signup forms

The emfluence form builder lives right inside WordPress. Drag and drop fields, assign groups, set consent text, and embed your form anywhere—no code required.

  • Block — add the emfluence Signup Form block to any page or post
  • Shortcode — [emfluence_form id="123"]
  • Widget — drop a form into any classic widget area
  • Per-embed styling — set input and button colors, borders, radius, padding, and font sizes for each block to match your brand
  • Standard fields (name, email, phone, address, and more) plus custom fields from your emfluence account
  • Success messages or post-submit redirects

Transactional email

Route outbound wp_mail() messages—password resets, order confirmations, notifications—through emfluence’s transactional sending API. Send all mail or only messages that match recipient and subject rules. The plugin coexists with SMTP plugins and falls back to normal delivery if anything fails, so your site keeps working.

Hosted landing pages

Already building landing pages in emfluence? Embed them with the emfluence Iframe page block or the [emfluence_page id="…"] shortcode—optionally in a modal window.

Email & marketing automation

Design automated campaigns with the emfluence Workflow Canvas, send email and SMS with an intuitive editor, and trigger welcome series and nurture tracks the moment someone signs up on your WordPress site. Learn more about emfluence automation.

For developers

Extend the plugin with WordPress hooks: emfluence_platform_before_contact_save, emfluence_platform_after_contact_save, and emfluence_platform_transactional_email. Define EMFL_API_TOKEN in wp-config.php to keep the API token out of the database.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for emfluence.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open emfluence → Settings in the admin sidebar.
  5. Paste your API access token, click Save Changes, then click Test Connection.

Manual upload

  1. Upload the wp-emfluence-marketing-platform folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open emfluence → Settings, paste your API token, and click Test Connection.

Then create a form under emfluence → All Forms, publish it, and add it to a page with the emfluence Signup Form block.

Don’t have an emfluence account? Sign up for a free trial or log in to get your API token.
sections.faq:
What are the requirements?

  • WordPress 6.4 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • An emfluence Marketing Platform account and API access token
  • For transactional email routing: the sendTransactional endpoint enabled on your account (contact emfluence support if unsure)

What is emfluence?

emfluence is a marketing automation platform built for marketers—email, SMS, drag-and-drop workflow automation, landing pages, reporting, and real human support. This plugin is the bridge between your WordPress site and the platform.

Are coding skills needed?

No. Build forms with the drag-and-drop builder, style and embed them with a block, and connect with a single API token. No theme edits or custom code required.

Where do I get an API token?

Log in to the emfluence platform at emailer.emfluence.com and create an access token under your account/API settings. You can also define it in wp-config.php:

define( 'EMFL_API_TOKEN', 'your-token-here' );

Do I need an SMTP plugin for transactional email?

No. When transactional routing is enabled, WordPress mail goes through emfluence’s sending infrastructure. The plugin also coexists with existing SMTP plugins and falls back safely if routing fails.

Can I style a form differently on different pages?

Yes. Each emfluence Signup Form block has its own Form appearance settings, so the same form can match each page it appears on.

Where can I get help?

  • Phone: 877-813-6245 (877-81-EMAIL)
  • Email: MarketingAutomation@emfluence.com
  • Contact form: emarketingplatform.com/contact-us
  • API documentation: apidocs.emailer.emfluence.com/v1
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Upgrading from 2.x: your existing API key is carried over automatically.
  • Rebuilt plugin: native signup forms with drag-and-drop fields, groups, double opt-in, and captcha.
  • emfluence Signup Form block with per-embed styling, plus shortcode and widget.
  • emfluence Iframe page block and [emfluence_page] shortcode for hosted landing pages.
  • Optional transactional email routing through emfluence with recipient and subject rules.
